This article is a stub. Chronomix Corporation of Sunnyvale, California sold a battery-powered
eight-lane printing swim timer from 1977 and the nine-lane `CC721` from 1980, and by 1991 it was
also selling stroke watches and video systems to coaches.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers, and
[Cronus](cronus.md) for the stopwatches advertised alongside the CC721.
